question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The atmosphere at the consert was electric.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"consert"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"concert"**. (संगीत समारोह)

 
 
• **Example: **The band performed brilliantly at the concert.
 
 
 
• **"Concert"** refers to a musical performance given in public, typically by several performers or of several separate compositions. (संगीत समारोह)
 
 
• **Example: **We attended a beautiful concert at the park last night.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **was** (था): Past tense of "is," used to describe something that happened in the past.

 
 
• **Example:** The event was a huge success.
 
 
 
• **electric** (विद्युत): Relating to, operated by, or producing electricity.
 
 
• **Example:** The electric car is becoming more popular.
 
 
 
• **atmosphere** (वातावरण): The envelope of gases surrounding the earth or another planet; or the pervading tone or mood of a place, situation, or work of art.
 
 
• **Example:** The atmosphere at the party was lively and welcoming.
